name: search_smoke_beam
notes: Engineering smoke for the iterative search layer (interface v0.1.0, docs/项目记录/突变序列迭代搜索算法与代理接口实施方案_20261002.md §6 step 4). Budget 256 is the smoke scale; the beam is deliberately shrunk to 8x8 with 4+4 seeds so several generations run before the budget is exhausted. Produces one metrics row and a full search archive (snapshot/state/evaluated log/candidates/groups/summary). Nothing is labelled and nothing is PARKED; the existing 96-candidate hand-off batch is untouched.
